findings: Two Mackay renders (29 AL6000T, 33 MLJ5750T) carry a Port Phillip Boating Centre dealer plate with its phone number, legible at the held size; another dealership's name cannot print on a Northside Marine quote.

Every Mackay row in the price file points at Mackay-Trailers-Logo.png, a logo. The accepted Mackay renders (30, 32, 36) are model pictures and must be captioned as the model's, since the wheel and brake suffix is not visible; only 34 (PU5500T) is the single row of its model.
TA600-MOB (trl_redco:40) points in the price file at ta500-mob-02.jpg, a TA500, a sister model; the proposed TA600 shot (39) is tandem, the TA600T, so the single-axle TA600-MOB stays a gap.
The GFAB "- Black" sportski photograph (27) shows the Rooftop model; it may suit "Offroad Single Sportski Trailer with Rooftop - Black" only after someone confirms its axle count against that row.

The ePropulsion renders are tied by the manufacturer's own part numbers; the long, short and extra-short shaft renders are distinct pictures whose shaft lengths differ visibly, so each sits only on its own shaft row.
The seed names ePropulsion's SPIRIT 1.0 Evo "Sprint 1.0 EVO" and its Pod Drives "Pro Drive"; the depicts line records the maker's name beside the seed's.
The TA900TRI-EH render (40) wears a REDCO ALLOY SERIES decal while the row is named TINKA Aluminium; recorded in differs so the paper can caption it.
